output.summary: The decline is mostly a venue and context story, not a programming one. The move to Brightwater cut seats by 40% and added a hard commute. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the first year, against a peer median of -9%. Low-attendance subscribers doubled as a share. Committed subscribers renew at a steady 85%. Per-concert sales show no gap between programs with and without post-1945 works. The cathedral sells far better downtown. Peers lost a similar share of revenue without moving, so the regional trend also matters. Marketing effect is unproven because nothing is tracked. Non-renewal would forfeit grant money and rests on weak evidence. Do the segmented analysis first, use the cathedral dates and a shuttle, and keep the programming.
